changelog: Suggestions can now explain themselves. Settings has a new SMART SUGGESTIONS box: paste a nexos.ai API key and the "Because you watched" row is ranked properly, with a short line under each poster saying why it is there. Test & Save checks the key against the service before storing it, so a bad paste tells you straight away instead of failing quietly. The key stays on the device and survives updates. It is optional — without one the row works exactly as it does now, just without the explanations.
